evidence.primary: LulzBot TAZ 3.0 User Manual, 2013Q4, setup §1.1, Figs. 1.6, 1.8, 1.13–1.17
evidence.scope_note: The atlas entry is an unversioned SoMakeIt machine instance, not a confirmed TAZ 3.0 or 3.1. Official LulzBot source identifies TAZ 3.0 and 3.1 as distinct revisions; this evidence is a separate TAZ 3.0 reference only. The OHAI URL containing taz_3 has a workflow titled TAZ 2.1 Final Assembly and was excluded as TAZ 3 pinout evidence. The official TAZ 3.0 manual supplies six connector groups with counts (18 total local schedule positions), but no numbered cavities, face orientation, contact-role map, continuity, or machine fit. Local A–D locators are editorial aids, not source pin numbers. USB and DC supply contact schedules remain unknown. Every known reference position is OPEN; there are zero routed or guessed connections and no DB25 evidence.
